assets.description: Figure 1.2: Data flow (simplex, half-duplex, and full-duplex). assets.alt: Figure 1.12: A heterogeneous network made of four WANs and three LANs
assets.description: Figure 1.12: A heterogeneous network made of four WANs and three LANs. A heterogeneous internetwork combines four WANs and three LANs.
